note: Capture for the GMT900 Chevrolet Tahoe (third generation, 2007-2014 model years), the short-wheelbase sibling of the GMT900 Suburban. The held article infobox publishes the three extents and no curb weight, so the operating weight resolves to a labelled absent zero and the row still names the vehicle. The Tahoe's own extents are taken; the Suburban's are not carried across. Every value is grade claimed from a tier-5 compilation.
